comment: BastlPizza publishes no source. Everything above came from the maker's own configParam and configInput descriptions. Eight of the nineteen parameters sit at one position, the PITCH knob, and three more at the TIMBRE fader and two at the ENV knob: the widget shown is the one the current mode calls for and the others are hidden, so each gets its own line. Crust reads only channel 0 of every input; the channels byte is read only to test whether a cable is present. The VELOCITY jack doubles as a gate whenever TRIG is unpatched, with a 1.5V and 0.5V Schmitt pair — the maker's tooltips do not mention this. The Input Jack S&H switches are read one flag per jack, and skip the CV update on every sample that is not a trigger.
